name: jt-mini-pc
composeYaml:
# docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --env-file docker-compose.env up -d
# docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --env-file docker-compose.env down

services:
  gluetun:
    image: ${GLTN_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    environment:
      # See https://github.com/qdm12/gluetun/wiki
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=${GLTN_VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER}
      - OPENVPN_USER=${GLTN_OPENVPN_USERNAME}
      - OPENVPN_PASSWORD=${GLTN_OPENVPN_PASSWORD}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=${GLTN_SERVER_COUNTRIES}
      - SERVER_CITIES=${GLTN_SERVER_CITIES}
      - PORT_FORWARD_ONLY=${GLTN_PORT_FORWARD_ONLY}
      - TZ=${TIMEZONE_LOCATION}
    volumes:
      - ${GLTN_PATH}:/gluetun
    ports:
      - ${QBT_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${QBT_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${JF_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${JF_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${KVT_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${KVT_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${FB_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${FB_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${TCD_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${TCD_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${FLSR_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${FLSR_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${VLT_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${VLT_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${SNR_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${SNR_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${PLR_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${PLR_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${RDR_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${RDR_INTERNAL_PORT}
    restart: unless-stopped

  nginx:
    image: ${NX_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: nginx-proxy-manager
    ports:
      - ${NX_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${NX_INTERNAL_PORT}
      - ${NX_EXTERNAL_PORT_2}:${NX_INTERNAL_PORT_2}
      - ${NX_EXTERNAL_PORT_3}:${NX_INTERNAL_PORT_3}
    volumes:
      - ${NX_DATA_PATH}:/data
      - ${NX_LE_PATH}:/etc/letsencrypt
    networks:
      - default
      - vpn

  cloudflare-ddns:
    build:
      context: ${DDNS_BUILD_PATH}
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${DDNS_CONFIG_PATH}:/app/config.json
      - ${DDNS_SCRIPT_PATH}:/app/cloudflare_ddns.py
    networks:
      - default
      - vpn

  portainer:
    image: ${PT_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: portainer
    environment:
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    ports:
      - ${PT_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${PT_INTERNAL_PORT}
    volumes:
      - ${PT_SOCK_PATH}:/var/run/docker.sock
      - portainer_data:/data
      - ${PT_CONTAINERS_PATH}:/home/jt/containers
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - default
      - vpn

  homarr:
    image: ${HR_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: homarr
    environment:
      - SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${HR_SEK}
    volumes:
      - ${HR_SOCK_PATH}:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ${HR_APPDATA_PATH}:/appdata
    ports:
      - ${HR_EXTERNAL_PORT}:${HR_INTERNAL_PORT}
    restart: unless-stopped

  filebrowser:
    image: ${FB_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: filebrowser
    user: "0:0"
    cap_add:
     - CHOWN
     - DAC_OVERRIDE
     - FOWNER
     - SYS_ADMIN
    security_opt:
     - apparmor:unconfined
     - seccomp:unconfined
    volumes:
      - filebrowser_DB:/database
      - ${FB_DATA_PATH}:/srv:rshared
      - ${FB_CONFIG_PATH}:/config
    command: --disable-preview-resize --disable-exec --disable-thumbnails --root /srv
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun

  jellyfin:
    image: ${JF_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: jellyfin
    volumes:
      - ${JF_CONFIG_PATH}:/config
      - ${JF_CACHE_PATH}:/cache
      - ${JF_MEDIA_PATH}:/media
      - ${JF_OTHER_PATH}:/other
      - ${JF_AUD_PATH}:/audio
      - ${JF_TV_PATH}:/tv
    environment:
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  flaresolverr:
    image: ${FLSR_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: flaresolverr
    user: "0:0"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=${FLSR_LOG_LEVEL}
      - LOG_FILE=${FLSR_LOG_FILE}
      - LOG_HTML=${FLSR_LOG_HTML}
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=${FLSR_CAPTCHA_SOLVER}
      - TZ=${TIMEZONE_LOCATION}
    volumes:
      - ${FLSR_CONFIG_PATH}:/config
      - ${FLSR_LOG_FILE}:/logs
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  kavita:
    image: ${KVT_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: kavita
    volumes:
      - ${KVT_LIBRARY}:/library
      - ${KVT_CONFIG}:/kavita/config
    environment:
      - TZ=${TIMEZONE_LOCATION}
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  tachidesk:
    image: ${TCD_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: tachidesk
    volumes:
      - ${TCD_DOWNLOADS}:/home/suwayomi/.local/share/Tachidesk/downloads
      - ${TCD_CONFIG}:/home/suwayomi/.local/share/Tachidesk
    environment:
      - TZ=${TIMEZONE_LOCATION}
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
      - AUTH_MODE=${TCD_AUTH_MODE}
      - AUTH_USERNAME=${TCD_AUTH_USERNAME}
      - AUTH_PASSWORD=${TCD_AUTH_PASSWORD}
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  qbittorrent:
    image: ${QBT_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: qbittorrent
    environment:
      - QBT_EULA=${QBT_EULA}
      - QBT_WEBUI_PORT=${QBT_EXTERNAL_PORT}
      - TZ=${TIMEZONE_LOCATION}
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    volumes:
      - ${QBT_CONFIG_PATH}:/config
      - ${QBT_DOWNLOADS_PATH}:/downloads
      - ${QBT_DOWNLOADS_PATH_TWO}:/downloads_Two
      - ${QBT_DOWNLOADS_PATH_THREE}:/downloads_Three
      - ${QBT_TV_PATH}:/tv
      - ${QBT_MANGA_PATH}:/manga
      - ${QBT_SCRIPT}:/script
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "/script && exec /usr/bin/qbittorrent-nox --profile=/config --confirm-legal-notice"]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # sonarr:
    # image: ${SNR_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    # container_name: sonarr

      # - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}

    image: ${ANR_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: anidarr
    environment:
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    volumes:
      - ${ANR_CONFIG_PATH}:/config
      - ${SNR_Mount_PATH}:/data
      - ${QBT_DOWNLOADS_PATH_THREE}:/downloads_Three
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  prowlarr:
    image: ${PLR_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: prowlarr
    environment:
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    volumes:
      - ${PLR_CONFIG}:/config
      - ${SNR_Mount_PATH}:/data
      - ${QBT_DOWNLOADS_PATH_THREE}:/downloads_Three
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  radarr:
    image: ${RDR_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: radarr
    environment:
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    volumes:
      - ${RDR_CONFIG}:/config
      - ${SNR_Mount_PATH}:/data
      - ${QBT_DOWNLOADS_PATH_THREE}:/downloads_Three
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped

  vlt-tracker:
    image: ${VLT_OF_CONTAINER_IMAGE}
    container_name: vlt-tracker
    environment:
      - PUID=${PUID_VALUE}
      - PGID=${PGID_VALUE}
    volumes:
      - ${VLT_DATA_PATH}:/app/data
    depends_on:
      - gluetun
    network_mode: service:gluetun
    restart: unless-stopped
